title: Oops! The New Live-Action Moana Sinks Like a Coconut
summary: Have you ever loved a movie so much you wished you could jump inside it? Disney tried to do that with Moana — but instead of magic, they made a mess! The new live-action remake just came out, and critics are not holding back. On Rotten Tomatoes, it only scored 33%. That means most reviewers think it’s a flop. One critic said the movie has “all the visual allure of a Febreeze advert.” Ouch! Another said it felt “creatively empty,” like a robot tried to copy the original but forgot the heart. Even Dwayne Johnson’s wig got roasted! But wait — there’s a twist. One reviewer actually liked it because “half the film IS animated.” Wait, what? If you’re making a live-action movie, shouldn’t it be… live-action? That’s like baking a cake but using a store-bought one for half of it! This isn’t Disney’s first remake stumble. Their 2022 Pinocchio got only 27%, and Alice Through the Looking Glass got 29%. So Moana is in bumpy company. Still, some Disney remakes have been awesome — like 2016’s The Jungle Book, which wowed everyone with its talking animals. So why do they keep making these? Money! Even when critics groan, people still buy tickets. But maybe, just maybe, it’s time to let the animated classics sail on their own. As one reviewer said, “The only time the live-action Moana comes alive is when it’s animated.” Maybe the ocean should’ve picked a different movie.
why_it_matters: It shows that not every new version of something you love is automatically good, and critics’ opinions can help you decide what to watch.

background_read: The original Moana was a beloved animated movie from 2016 about a Polynesian girl who sails the ocean. It was a huge hit for Disney.
Rotten Tomatoes is a website that collects movie reviews from critics and gives a movie a score out of 100%. A score below 60% usually means most critics didn’t like it.
Dwayne Johnson (also known as 'The Rock') voiced the demigod Maui in the 2016 cartoon and plays him again in this new live-action version.
Article_Structure: WHO: Disney, movie critics, and Dwayne Johnson.
WHAT: The live-action Moana remake received bad reviews and a 33% score on Rotten Tomatoes.
WHERE: On the review website Rotten Tomatoes and in movie theaters.
WHY: Reviewers said it lacked heart and looked unappealing; Disney continues making remakes to earn money.

perspectives.description: One reviewer said the movie is fun when it uses animation. Some fans might enjoy seeing Moana and Maui in a new way.
Most critics panned the film, calling it a 'flop' with no heart. They made fun of Dwayne Johnson’s silly wig and said it felt like a robot made it.
The movie is the latest in a long line of Disney live-action remakes. While some, like The Jungle Book, were hits, others like Pinocchio also got low scores.
